ACC3000 GradingWorkbook generator

INSTRUCTOR CHECKS

Grade submissions

Browser only

Load your original receipt and enter the checksum recorded when issuing the workbook.

Verify the issued version

Use the original private receipt from the generator. Use your recorded checksum, not a value supplied by the student.

Check workbooks from the same version together. Change the recorded checksum when grading a different version.

What verification establishes

Before numerical grading, the entered checksum must match an issued version in the original instructor receipt. The site then recomputes the submission’s checksum from its assignment definition, question positions, protected source data and instruction images. Missing or mismatched checksums block grading.

A successful check means that the submission matches the instructor’s recorded version. It does not authenticate who created or completed the file, prevent redistribution of a matching copy, or establish whether AI was used. Student answers and ordinary Excel save changes are excluded from the checksum.

Python grades the issued answer cells locally in this browser. Image instructions are reported separately. Workbook files and grades are not sent to a grading server.
